flowchart LR subgraph CENTRAL_TIER["Central / Client Tier"] WEB_APP["Web Client (web/index.html & app.js)"] EXPLAINER["Interactive Explainer (explainer/index.html)"] WEB_BT["Web Bluetooth API (navigator.bluetooth)"] end
subgraph BRIDGE_TIER["Simulation & Transport Tier"] HTTP_SSE["Zero-Dependency Server (simulator/server.js)"] REST_API["REST Endpoints (/api/status, /api/gatt/*)"] SSE_STREAM["Server-Sent Events (/api/events)"] end
subgraph PERIPHERAL_TIER["Peripheral Tier"] GATT_DB["Simulated GATT Database (Battery, HR, Custom Control)"] TELEMETRY["Telemetry Engine (simulator/telemetry.js)"] ESP32["Optional ESP32 Firmware (hardware/esp32/ble_peripheral.ino)"] end
subgraph DATA_TIER["Visuals & Datasets"] DATASET["data/telemetry.sample.json"] PLOTS["docs/img/*.svg"] end
WEB_APP <--> WEB_BT WEB_BT -. Physical BLE .-> ESP32 WEB_APP <--> HTTP_SSE EXPLAINER <--> HTTP_SSE HTTP_SSE --> REST_API & SSE_STREAM REST_API & SSE_STREAM <--> GATT_DB GATT_DB --> TELEMETRY TELEMETRY --> DATASET DATASET --> PLOTS
